name: Transvoxel
definition: A geometry shader implementation of Transvoxel that handles level-of-detail (LOD) transitions in voxel grids by adjusting vertex positions and normals to maintain a watertight surface when neighboring voxels have different resolutions.
summary: Transvoxel is an LOD-aware Marching Cubes technique that maintains watertight meshes across hierarchical grids by using transition cells to interpolate vertices between different resolutions.
